title: Composite Materials
description: Stiff fibres in a light matrix: along the fibres, the composite is as stiff as the mixture of the two by volume (the rule of mixtures, E = V_f·E_f + V_m·E_m), and far lighter than metal. Off the fibre direction it is weak, so plies are laid at angles; pack the fibres too tight and the matrix cannot wet them, and voids weaken it. Unlocks the Composite Layup Press: carbon-fibre and nanotube composites.

puzzle.goal: Fibres of modulus E_f fill a fraction V_f of a part; the rest is matrix of modulus E_m. Along the fibres both stretch alike. Write the part's modulus E.
puzzle.name: The rule of mixtures
puzzle.ask: Find E in GPa for V_f = @{Vf}, E_f = @{Ef} GPa and E_m = @{Em} GPa.
puzzle.method: Equal strain in both: the stresses add, each weighted by the share of the section it carries.
